fridge_swing.source: ESTIMATED from viewer screenshots: fridge door ahead of the route start

sink.source: ESTIMATED from viewer screenshots: standing spot at the double sink

entrance.source: ESTIMATED: where the planned route leaves the kitchen

hall.source: where the scanned nightlight is plugged in

kitchen.source: ASSUMED outlet: the add_nightlight fix's spot; mark real outlets (BLOCKERS.md)

taped.label: Tape the mat's edges down
taped.assumption: ASSUMPTION: taped edges stop the simulated slide and corner fold; the 1.5 cm edge stays (toe contacts unchanged)

rerouted.label: Run the cord along the wall instead of across the path
rerouted.assumption: ASSUMPTION: the cord leaves the floor box entirely (same map effect as taping), clips and labour estimated

caps.label: Glide caps or slit tennis balls on the walker's rear legs
caps.product: walker glide caps (or 2 tennis balls, slit)
caps.assumption: ASSUMPTION: caps cut the glide-on-rug friction to 0.10-0.20 (not measured); the mat's slide / fold events scale by the cloth-rug sim's fold-or-drag rate with caps over without (physics/rug_calib.json)

search.note: simulated annealing on risk + effort_weight * effort (risk is per month, ~70-220 here; effort ~1-3 per change), one weight per group of chains so the chains together trace the risk-vs-effort front
